answer: The nadir of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Every claim climbs the bridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the oasis re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
